device_entry.name: 工业相机
device_entry.description: 工业相机是一类用于机器视觉和科研成像的电子成像设备，常用于实验中的图像采集、目标检测、尺寸测量和过程监控。此处证据显示设备支持通过底层寄存器端口进行打开、关闭、读写和访问模式查询，符合实验室中可编程视觉设备的典型控制方式。
device_entry.description_en: An industrial camera is an electronic imaging device used for machine vision and scientific imaging. It is commonly used in laboratories for image acquisition, object detection, dimensional measurement, and process monitoring. The evidence here indicates low-level register-port access with open, close, read, write, and access-mode queries, which is typical of programmable vision devices used in lab setups.
